title: Hopeverse: Tamil Dance Number v3 (instrumental, clearly Tamil)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_global_styles: Tamil film kuthu dance number, Chennai street festival, composed like a film composer, not a DJ mix
raw, loud, live Tamil folk percussion up front: parai and thappu frame drums in the kuthu swing, urumi drum, thavil, about 100 BPM
a live nadaswaram plays a catchy Tamil folk melody, major with a flat seventh, with gamakam slides; a chopped, bent nadaswaram synth answers it
pitched-down thavil as the bass, ghatam and kanjira as glitchy top percussion
loud, clear, punchy mix with deep drums

positive_local_styles: ONLY one instrument: a lone live nadaswaram plays a rising 3-note call: root, minor third, fifth, held and bent up
a lone parai frame drum joins under the nadaswaram synth, teasing the triplet swing
still no bass
the full kuthu band crashes in: thappu and parai triplet swing, pitched-down thavil bass, brass punches
the live nadaswaram announces the tune
deep bass enters here, at 8 seconds
new texture: the live nadaswaram plays the main Tamil folk tune on the swing
chopped nadaswaram riff answers each phrase
ghatam and kanjira glitch fills
bass and big drums step out, played by the band
only a kanjira and a lone nadaswaram phrase remain
ends with one reversed veena swell into a huge unison hit
surprise change of gait: the rhythm switches from triplet swing to a straight four-beat dappu pattern
the main hook: live nadaswaram and brass in unison, bigger than everything before
the triplet swing returns
parai, thappu, urumi and thavil trade phrases, speeding up
ends on a phrase played three times that lands exactly on beat one
new top: strings join the counter-melody
highest energy triplet kuthu groove, brass, live nadaswaram lead with the synth answering
louder than the first hook
the 3-note call again on the nadaswaram synth over the drums
one big unison hit, then stop

brief.notes: Jithesh 29 Oct on v1: track really good but doesn't sound Tamil, and the konnakol gibberish words don't suit it. v3: no words at all, raw Tamil folk instruments up front (parai, thappu, urumi, thavil, live nadaswaram hook in a Tamil folk mode), processed sounds only as the second layer. Keeps rule 9.11 structure from v2.

story: A Tamil film dance number: the hero and the crowd take over the street festival.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
